relatedLegacyApps.name: Bonsai Balance
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A portrait-first balance puzzle for phones. Tap chunky left and right leaf controls, prune the heavy branch, certify when the needle rests inside the glowing target band, chain combo time bonuses, unlock Aurora leaves at 1400 points, and chase your saved best score offline.

relatedLegacyApps.name: Gust Garden
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A portrait-first wind drawing arcade game for phones. Swipe anywhere to draw gust paths, push mint, rose, and gold leaves into matching pouches, spend one Calm Pulse rescue, chain combo catches, unlock Moon Path at 2200 points, and chase your saved best score offline.

relatedLegacyApps.name: Canopy Catch
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A portrait-first arcade catcher for phones. Drag a chunky basket to catch acorns, berries, and leaves, build combo bonuses, dodge thorn drops, and chase your saved best score offline.

relatedLegacyApps.name: Rainline Rescue
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A portrait-first rain catcher for phones. Tap or drag across five wide lanes to catch blue drops and gold sun beads, let red sparks pass, protect your leaves, unlock a faster storm at 650 points, and chase your saved best score offline.

relatedLegacyApps.name: Word Wharf
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A portrait-first letter conveyor game for phones. Tap the next target-word letter before matching crates leave the belt, manage the jam meter, unlock a copper dock, and chase your saved best score offline.

relatedLegacyApps.name: Pocket Sudoku
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A mobile-first 9x9 Sudoku logic puzzle for phones. Tap cells and number buttons to fill the grid, use notes mode for pencil marks, undo mistakes, get 3 hints per game, and chase your best time offline.

relatedLegacyApps.name: Meteor Defense
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A Missile Command-style arcade defense game! Tap anywhere to launch interceptors — destroy falling meteors before they hit your cities. 3 missiles per salvo, auto-reload, blast radius explosions, and city destruction. Each wave adds more & faster meteors. 5 lives (cities), score tracking, best score saved in localStorage. Neon glow visuals, meteor trails, starfield sky. Mobile-first tap-to-launch controls. Fully offline.

relatedLegacyApps.name: Raindrop Rally
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A mobile-first pond juggling arcade game where you tap swollen leaves for points, cool neighboring leaves with splash chains, and survive a 75-second storm.

relatedLegacyApps.name: ShiftSync
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A professional employee shift scheduling and workforce management SaaS for restaurants, hospitality, and retail teams. Features a weekly calendar view with color-coded shift blocks (Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Night/OnCall), full employee CRUD with roles, hourly rates, and availability tracking, conflict detection for overlapping shifts, time-off request workflow with approve/reject, reports dashboard with weekly hours bar charts, employee hour breakdowns, labor cost calculations, and coverage stats. Includes dark/light theme toggle, JSON export/import, and 100% localStorage persistence. Pre-seeded with 6 employees, 18 shifts across all 7 days, and 2 time-off requests. Works fully offline.

relatedLegacyApps.name: ApprovalsDesk
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A professional approval workflow management SaaS for HR, operations, and finance teams. Features a 6-stage approval pipeline Kanban board (Draft/Submitted/Pending/Approved/Rejected/Cancelled), 5 request types (Expense/PTO/Purchase/Equipment/Travel), multi-level approver chain assignment with sequential workflow, priority tiers (Low/Medium/High/Urgent) with color-coded urgency, approval chain visualization with progress indicators, threaded comments per request, request statistics dashboard with status donut charts and priority bar charts, team member directory with request counts, search and multi-filter by type/status/priority, and 100% localStorage persistence. Pre-seeded with 8 realistic requests across all statuses, 6 team members, and 2 approval chains.

relatedLegacyApps.name: SyncBoard
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A professional employee attendance tracking and team availability management SaaS for teams. Features real-time check-in/out board, week attendance rate tracking, monthly attendance heatmap, 7-day calendar view with week navigation, leave request management with approval workflow, team member directory with PTO/sick/WFH balance tracking, SVG donut and bar analytics, CSV/JSON export, dark/light theme toggle, and 100% localStorage persistence. Pre-seeded with 6 team members and 4 weeks of realistic attendance data.

relatedLegacyApps.name: ApprovalDesk
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A multi-level approval workflow management SaaS for HR and operations teams. Features 5 request types (Expense/PTO/Purchase/Equipment/Travel), configurable multi-level approval chains with per-level approver assignment, priority tiers (Low/Medium/High/Urgent), full status lifecycle (Draft/Submitted/Pending/Approved/Rejected/Cancelled), approval chain visualization with approve/reject actions, threaded comments per request, KPI dashboard with status distribution donut charts and type bar charts, team directory with per-member request stats, search/filter by type/status/priority, and 100% localStorage persistence. Pre-seeded with 8 realistic requests across all statuses, 6 team members, and pre-configured approval chains.

relatedLegacyApps.name: ShiftSync
relatedLegacyApps.desc: Smart employee shift scheduling SaaS with weekly calendar grid, conflict detection (overlapping shifts, insufficient rest), time-off requests with approve/reject, shift swap management, analytics dashboard with labor cost tracking, and CSV export. 100% localStorage. Pre-seeded with 5 employees.

relatedLegacyApps.name: CrewCal
relatedLegacyApps.desc: A team availability & scheduling SaaS with weekly calendar view, event scheduling, team member management, PTO tracking, visual PTO indicators, and 100% localStorage persistence.

relatedLegacyApps.name: 3D Print Doctor — Failure Diagnosis Tool
relatedLegacyApps.desc: An interactive visual tool that helps makers diagnose 3D printing failures. Select symptoms from illustrated examples, get detailed diagnosis with causes, solutions, and prevention tips for 12 common failure types.
